name: aiapplyd
description: Auto-Apply That Ends on an Interview. Get matched jobs, apply on 34 hiring systems automatically or after your approval, review and track every application, and tailor your resume and cover letter per role.

interface.shortDescription: Find jobs and apply to them
interface.longDescription:
AI Applyd helps you look for a job from ChatGPT. It shows the jobs matched to your resume and job preferences, scores your resume against a job description, tailors your resume and cover letter to a specific role, and prepares you for interviews.

When you choose to apply, AI Applyd fills in and submits the application on the employer's own hiring site. You can hold each application for your approval before it is sent, and you can check the status of the applications you already sent.

You need an AI Applyd account. ChatGPT asks you to sign in the first time you use it.
defaultPrompt: Show me my best job matches.
Find remote UX designer jobs in my matches.
Help me prepare for an interview at Stripe.

positive.description: List the jobs matched to the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: Show me my best job matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the user's matched jobs as a list. Each job shows the title, company, location, match score and a link to the posting.

positive.description: Search the matched jobs by title and remote preference.
positive.prompt: Find remote UX designer jobs in my matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matched jobs that fit UX designer and allow remote work. Each job shows the title, company, location, match score and a link to the posting.

positive.description: Score a resume against a pasted job description.
positive.prompt: Score my resume against this job: Senior Data Analyst, SQL, Python, Tableau, 5+ years. My resume: Data analyst with 6 years of SQL and Python, built Tableau dashboards for finance teams.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an overall ATS score out of 100, section scores, the matched and missing keywords, and suggestions to improve the resume.

positive.description: List the keywords a job description screens for.
positive.prompt: What does this posting screen for? Backend Engineer: Go, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, 4+ years, on-call rotation, fintech experience preferred.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the keywords the posting screens for, split into must-have and nice-to-have, with a category and an importance score for each keyword.

positive.description: Prepare for an interview at a named company.
positive.prompt: Help me prepare for a Customer Success Manager interview at Stripe.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns interview prep for the role: company insights, likely interview questions, STAR stories, questions to ask the interviewer and negotiation prep.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated weather questions.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for general coding help.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.
Give me a quick recipe for vegetable soup.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments. Paid AI Applyd plans are bought on aiapplyd.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.8.2: adds tools to list job matches, apply or hold for review, approve or skip held applications, track application status, read the account and plan, save a resume, and save or skip matches. Faster connection setup.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-Apply That Ends on an Interview
interface.longDescription:
AI Applyd finds jobs that fit your resume, rewrites the resume and writes a cover letter for each role, and applies on the company's own hiring system across 34 hiring systems, including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, Workable, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, ADP and Dayforce. Send each application automatically, or hold it in a review queue for your yes. It keeps the confirmation the employer sends back, so you know every application landed.

Ask for your matched jobs, apply to one, approve or reject what is waiting, track where every application stands, tailor your resume and cover letter for a posting, or prepare for an interview, without leaving the chat.
defaultPrompt: Show me my best job matches.
Apply to the best match for me and hold it for my review.
What applications are waiting for my approval?
